categories_swept: P0 Security sweep (js-dom new surface: Worker/WebSocket/Blob; image decode caps)

closed_issues_checked: #23 (find_ci O(n²), closed — precedent class for new #229)
corpus.notes: An intermediate automated run on 2026-08-02 filed #204-#227 and enriched #196 — the tree (through v0.0.19, last commit 81255fa 2026-07-30) was exhaustively covered two days before this run. Dedup bar was very high; deep-dived v0.0.14-v0.0.19 churn (cerberus-text/hinted.rs glyph cache, viewport cull, cerberus-app layout cache/render_frame, cerberus-ui, cerberus-css polygon/font-face additions, cerberus-dom parser, cerberus-paint, js-dom Worker/WebSocket shims, winit scroll path).

findings.title: decode_entities scans to the next ';' anywhere in the remaining text for every '&' — O(n²) HTML parse on ampersand-dense text nodes

draw_polygon (added v0.0.14) shares #196's missing loop-bound intersection AND has an unbounded per-scanline O(vertices) factor + per-scanline sort; parse_clip_polygon caps neither vertex count nor coordinate magnitude

GlyphCache::insert has no per-item ceiling: one CachedGlyph (up to 16 MiB under MAX_GLYPH_RASTER=4096) above the 4 MiB cap makes every insert wholesale-clear — page-wide cache hit rate ~0 per frame, reverting the v0.0.16 scroll win; #205's font-size clamp alone does not remove it

duplicates_skipped: paint_vspan glyph-run span reads GlyphBox.h (always 0) → exact match of #204, skipped
DisplayList::scaled(1.0) full deep clone per frame + render_frame's clone of cached display/links/fields/elements → covered by #207 ('deep-cloned twice, translated, rescanned'), skipped
collect_computed + set_computed_styles pushed into JS every frame → covered by #22, skipped
synchronous subresource image decode in poll → #211, skipped
table-nesting cap bypass via Ctx::sub → #220, skipped
HintingInstance map unbounded / font-size unclamped → #205 body, skipped (only the GlyphCache degenerate mode was new → enrichment)
draw_image/gradient/shadow/round_rect full-rect iteration → #196 body, skipped (only draw_polygon was new → enrichment)
not_filed_below_bar: extract_font_face_families allocates a full to_ascii_lowercase() copy of all author CSS inside every parse_stylesheet call — additive detail on #172 (author CSS re-parsed per restyle); #172's fix (cache the parsed sheet) removes it automatically
finish_positioned negative-z prepend (v0.0.17) is an O(items) Vec prepend per context — bounded, once per layout, not per frame; below bar
build_tree per-text-token stack.iter().any(pre check) and close_element rposition — O(depth<=512) per token, bounded; below bar
shape_in_styled/itemize per-call Vec allocations — same churn family as existing #26/#178/#183/#187; nothing distinct enough to add
draw_line iterates the segment bounding box — chrome/icon-only emitters found, not author-reachable at scale; below bar
no_findings_areas: cerberus-image: decode caps present and tested (DEFAULT_MAX_DECODE_PIXELS 6M, 1600px longest side, 4 MiB SVG byte ceiling)
cerberus-shell-winit scroll path: wheel deltas go through request_redraw() (winit-coalesced), no per-event relayout
cerberus-js-dom Worker/WebSocket/Blob shims (v0.0.14): same-thread, timer-queue-scheduled, no thread spawn; WebSocket is a stub — no new P0 surface beyond filed issues
cerberus-ui toolbar/panel painting: fixed small control count, not a hot path
hinted.rs cache-key correctness verified: baseline is integer (origin.y + ascent().round()) so the missing y-phase in the glyph-cache key is sound; sub-pixel bucket keying is translation-invariant
overall_health: Good code trajectory, exceptionally well-audited backlog. The tree through v0.0.19 was swept exhaustively by the 2026-08-02 run (#204-#227), so this rotation's yield is honest and small: one new genuine O(n²) parse hot path (#229, same class as the fixed #23) and two material scope enrichments on open perf issues (#196 draw_polygon, #205 GlyphCache thrash mode). The dominant open risks remain the previously-filed HIGH perf items (#170 exponential layout, #175 O(N²) display list, #195 full-DOM serialize per event, #210 no connection reuse, #213 JS budget gaps, #220 table-cap bypass) — fixing capacity, not finding capacity, is the bottleneck.
